_comment: Recorded /converse answers of a scripted kervan-voice, one list entry per turn, for --today 2026-10-09. Every bundled scenario passes against these.

status-lookup.reply: Your parcel KRV10000001 is in transit from Izmir to Ankara. Estimated delivery: 2026-10-11.

reschedule-happy-path.reply: Done: the delivery of KRV10000002 is rescheduled to 2026-10-12 (afternoon).

reschedule-missing-code.reply: I can move KRV10000003 to 2026-10-10. Please tell me the 4-digit verification code (the last four digits of the recipient's phone).

reschedule-delivered-refused.reply: Sorry, KRV10000004 cannot be rescheduled: it has already been delivered or is out for delivery.

damaged-parcel-ticket.reply: I'm sorry about that. I opened ticket TCK-000123 for the damaged parcel KRV10000005; our team will contact you.

arguments.description: My parcel KRV10000005 arrived damaged. The box was crushed and the vase inside is broken.

result.description: My parcel KRV10000005 arrived damaged. The box was crushed and the vase inside is broken.

lost-parcel-ticket.reply: I opened ticket TCK-000124 to trace KRV10000006 as a lost parcel.

help-question.reply: From our help centre: Changing the delivery address - you can change the address until the parcel is out for delivery.

arguments.query: How do I change the delivery address of a parcel?

results.title: Changing the delivery address
results.snippet: You can change the address until the parcel is out for delivery.

unknown-tracking-number.reply: I could not find a shipment with tracking number KRV99999999. Please check the number.

no-reschedule-without-code.reply: I can move KRV10000007 to 2026-10-10. Please tell me the 4-digit verification code.
I can only reschedule with the verification code: the last four digits of the recipient's phone.
Sorry, I cannot reschedule without the verification code. Please send it when you have it.
